parameters.query:
WITH current_session AS (
  SELECT
    s.actor_id,
    s.role,
    s.email,
    s.expires_at
  FROM public.taxi_auth_sessions s
  WHERE s.token_hash = $1::TEXT
    AND s.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND s.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
    AND s.role IN ('CLIENT', 'DRIVER')
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM current_session
  ) AS valid_session,
  (
    SELECT row_to_json(s)
    FROM current_session s
  ) AS session;
